entries.title: Psalms 130:1
segments:
Out of the depths; of affliction. 
 
The right effect of distress, whether outward or inward, is to produce sincere and earnest prayer to God, and such prayer will always be heard and answered.

entries.title: Psalms 130:3
segments:
Mark iniquities; for the purpose of punishing them. 
 
No man can stand before God on the ground of his innocency.  His only hope is in God's forgiving mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: That thou mayest be feared; that is, with holy filial fear. Without the assurance that God will forgive the penitent, no man could approach him with such fear.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
segments: When deliverance is long delayed, it is good to wait upon God in quiet submission and humble obedience.  When the right time has come, he will cause the morning to shine.

entries.title: Psalms 130:8
segments:
From all his iniquities; from sin and the suffering that follows sin. 
 
God's work in behalf of his people will not be complete till he has abolished sin in their souls, and all the consequences of sin in their souls, bodies, and estate.
